## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] AbbVie announced FDA approval of VYALEV, foscarbidopa and foslevodopa, for motor fluctuations in adults with advanced Parkinson’s disease; this claim records the sponsor’s announcement. (low confidence) (verified as of 2024-10-17) — https://news.abbvie.com/2024-10-17-U-S-FDA-Approves-VYALEV-TM-foscarbidopa-and-foslevodopa-for-Adults-Living-with-Advanced-Parkinsons-Disease
- [statement] FDA’s Onapgo approval letter identifies NDA 214056 as an application under section 505(b)(1) for apomorphine hydrochloride injection to treat motor fluctuations in adults with advanced Parkinson’s disease. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-02-03) — https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/appletter/2025/214056Orig1s000ltr.pdf

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] EMA lists EMA/CHMP/330418/2012 rev. 2 as the current effective Parkinson’s guideline; its later concept paper proposes replacing that guideline, rather than constituting an adopted replacement. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-27) — https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/scientific-guidelines/clinical-investigation-medicinal-products-treatment-parkinsons-disease · keywords: Regulatory pathways (FDA, EMA) for PD therapies · also: https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/scientific-guideline/concept-paper-need-revision-guideline-clinical-investigation-medicinal-products-treatment-parkinsons-disease_en.pdf

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The historical EMA Parkinson’s guideline CPMP/EWP/563/95 Rev.1 records CHMP adoption on 24 July 2008 and coming into effect on 1 February 2009. (low confidence) (verified as of 2008-07-24) — https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/scientific-guideline/guideline-clinical-investigation-medicinal-products-treatment-parkinsons-disease_en.pdf
- [statement] EMA’s DAT imaging letter supports further development and validation; the Stephenson review reports a subsequent full Qualification Opinion in 2018 for DAT enrichment in Parkinson’s trials targeting early motor symptoms. (low confidence) (verified as of 2019-07-30) — https://media.c-path.org/wp-content/uploads/20240427170245/cpp_ema_letter_of_support_cpp_imaging_biomarker-1.pdf · keywords: Regulatory pathways (FDA, EMA) for PD therapies · also: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6700608/
- [statement] FDA letter DDT-BMQ-000157 supports binary assessment of alpha-synuclein seed amplification as an enrichment biomarker for patient selection in trials targeting disorders with common synuclein biology. (low confidence) (verified as of 2024-08-19) — https://www.fda.gov/media/181368/download
- [statement] FDA states that a biomarker letter of support does not imply biomarker qualification and does not endorse a specific biomarker test or device. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-27) — https://www.fda.gov/drugs/biomarker-qualification-program/letter-support-los
- [statement] FDA reports that Onapgo real-world evidence contributed additional safety data, but significant limitations in adverse-event data made it unsuitable for inclusion in product labeling. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-27) — https://www.fda.gov/science-research/real-world-evidence/cder-drug-approvals-used-real-world-evidence
- [statement] FDA’s safety summary identifies adaptive deep brain stimulation as device supplement P960009/S478 and dates its approval notice February 20, 2025; FDA’s roundup describes marketing approval on February 21. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-02-28) — https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/cdrh_docs/pdf/P960009S478B.pdf · keywords: Regulatory pathways (FDA, EMA) for PD therapies · also: https://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-roundup-february-28-2025
- [statement] AbbVie states that PRODUODOPA marketing authorization was granted through the Decentralized Procedure in the third quarter of 2022. (low confidence) (verified as of 2024-01-09) — https://news.abbvie.com/2024-01-09-AbbVie-Launches-PRODUODOPA-R-foslevodopa-foscarbidopa-for-People-Living-with-Advanced-Parkinsons-Disease-in-the-European-Union
